group_too_small.says: a release would be about fewer people than allowed
group_too_small.suggest: report on a larger group, or ask more people of the group

difference_too_small.says: two releases would differ by fewer people than allowed
difference_too_small.suggest: report on the same group as before, or on one that differs by enough people

label_blocked.says: data of the wrong origin would flow into a parameter
label_blocked.suggest: take the value from our own data, not from the message or the document

unknown_account.says: the account is not in the master data
unknown_account.suggest: hand it to a person who checks the counterparty and the master data

unknown_recipient.says: the recipient is not in the master data, or not the person the data is about
unknown_recipient.suggest: report to a recipient in the master data, or a person adds this one there

already_done.says: the item already has this action
already_done.suggest: nothing to do: the item already has this action

budget_cap.says: the sum would exceed its cap
budget_cap.suggest: pay less this round, or ask the client for a higher cap

soft_rule.says: a rule of the user's base setup would be broken

plan_refused.says: the plan did not pass the plan check
plan_refused.suggest: choose a strategy whose data flow fits the goal

child_failed.says: a child could not reach its goal

precondition_missing.says: something the goal depends on is not there yet
precondition_missing.suggest: make the missing precondition a goal of its own

no_reaction.says: the other side did not react in time
no_reaction.suggest: wait a little longer, remind, or try another channel

not_reached.says: the other side could not be reached

unachievable.says: a fact makes the criterion impossible
unachievable.suggest: ask the client whether the goal can change

conflict.says: facts from different origins contradict each other
conflict.suggest: ask a person which of the facts holds

not_confirmed.says: the goal is not confirmed at the gate

approval_void.says: the approval no longer fits the action: it is missing, used or expired, the action is no longer waiting for it, or its content changed since (F2 to F5)
approval_void.suggest: ask the person to approve the action again as it stands now

request_unreadable.says: the gate could not read the request as it stands: no object, a field of the wrong kind, or too large (A8)
request_unreadable.suggest: hand it to a person: the plan built a request the gate cannot check

person_busy.says: too many actions of this goal already wait for a person (P6)
person_busy.suggest: wait until the person decided what already waits

unclear.says: it is not clear whether the action took effect

not_sent.says: the action was withdrawn before it was sent

aborted.says: the node was aborted from above or by its client

lease_expired.says: a move ran past its lease and was ended; what it produced was discarded

interrupted.says: the core stopped while the move ran; the move counts as aborted and the strategy may run again
